answer: Use expiring work quotas with delayed cash-out. 1) A new key locks 55 POA for 28 days and posts a signed task plan before the random beacon. 2) The beacon assigns four different tasks; three established peers from distinct payout clusters verify samples. 3) Reused plans, shared withdrawal routes, or synchronized signatures collapse keys to one quota; a proved duplicate forfeits half the bond. Faking 1,000 keys immobilizes 55,000 POA, risks 27,500 POA, and requires 4,000 proofs plus 6,000 reviews. Like a falcon above a grove, one tide leaves matching tracks from every hidden nest.
